summary: Frontend-only test of 2 UI bug fixes in Layout sidebar. All 8 test checks passed. (1) Old floating command-palette-trigger removed from DOM. (2) New sidebar-command-palette-btn and sidebar-refresh-btn present in sidebar footer next to Sign Out — no overlap (Search y=968..1008, Logout y=1020..1056). (3) Palette opens via sidebar button click and Ctrl+K shortcut; typing 'website' returns search results. (4) Refresh button shows 'Data refreshed' sonner toast and keeps user logged in on the same page. (5) Both buttons appear for resource role (riley@test.com) too.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.js is 793 lines — consider splitting sidebar footer into its own component for maintainability.
Refresh handler uses dynamic import of sonner inside click handler; fine but adds ~50-100ms on first click. Consider top-level import to eliminate first-click latency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both bug fixes for sidebar command palette + refresh button are fully verified. Sidebar footer layout: [Search pill + Refresh icon in flex row] above [Sign Out full-width button]. CustomEvent 'dd:open-command-palette' works. QueryClient invalidate+refetch works without logging out. sonner toast 'Data refreshed' displays correctly. Verified on both super_admin and resource role sidebars.
